name: Electronics Project Enclosure
description: 80 x 50 x 22 mm electronics project box: 3 mm walls, four M2.5 screw bosses, and a lipped lid shown exploded above the body (two bodies).

steps.instruction: Create the enclosure body blank: a solid block 80 mm long (X), 50 mm wide (Y) and 22 mm tall (Z), centered in X and Y with its base on Z=0.

transcript.user_prompt: Create the enclosure body blank: a solid block 80 mm long (X), 50 mm wide (Y) and 22 mm tall (Z), centered in X and Y with its base on Z=0.

steps.instruction: Hollow the interior: cut a 74 x 44 mm pocket from Z=2.5 up through the open top, leaving 3 mm walls and a 2.5 mm floor.

steps.instruction: Add four corner screw bosses inside the cavity: cylinders of radius 4 mm centered at (X, Y) = (+/-34, +/-19), rising from the floor at Z=2.5 to the rim at Z=22, fused into the walls.

steps.instruction: Drill a blind self-tapping pilot hole down the centre of each boss: radius 1.25 mm, 16 mm deep from the rim at Z=22 (hole bottom at Z=6).

steps.instruction: Add the lid as a second body, shown exploded 8 mm above the box: an 80 x 50 x 3 mm plate with its underside at Z=30, plus a 73 x 43 x 2 mm locating lip protruding below it (0.5 mm clearance to the cavity). Keep body and lid as two separate solids in a Compound.

steps.instruction: Drill M2.5 clearance holes of radius 1.35 mm through the lid and its lip, one above each boss at (X, Y) = (+/-34, +/-19).
